user.title: Connect to Aruba Instant
user.description: Monitor a locally managed Aruba Instant AOS-8 virtual controller. The site ID identifies stored data and entities and cannot be changed later.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Aruba credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected its renewed session. Enter working credentials to resume collection.

reconfigure.title: Configure controller connection
reconfigure.description: The site ID and retained campaign data stay the same. Leave the password blank to keep the saved password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the controller. Check its address, TLS settings and network access.
error.unsupported_controller: The controller does not support a required Instant show command.
error.invalid_response: A required controller table could not be validated after retrying.
error.invalid_config: Check the site ID, controller address, port and timing settings.
error.unknown: Unexpected connection check failure. Check the controller settings and try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Aruba Monitor instance is supported.
abort.already_configured: This Aruba Monitor site is already configured.

error.invalid_config: Use a polling interval of at least five seconds and a positive HTTP timeout.
